statement: Pinned SDL HIDAPI Wii controller code enables continuous data reporting and treats three seconds without incoming input as a lost connection requiring reopening. This is a host-side disconnection heuristic, not the required cadence for individual Wii Remote report modes or a physical radio timeout.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_wii.c 36-38,1532-1545; do not infer a report rate.
